hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the univariate kernel K(x)=V(x)*G0(x)*V(x). Instantiate K at x=p and x=q. The full expression is the sum of these two specializations.
required_assumptions: V and G0 are univariate functions that accept the symbolic arguments p and q.
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are identical up to the renaming p/q, so they are evaluations of a common parameterized kernel at two different symbolic inputs.
